User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user account within the GridFocus application.

inviteCode.description: A unique, short, and secure alphanumeric code for inviting friends.

seenWhatsNewVersions.description: An array of version strings for 'What's New' announcements the user has seen.

hasBeenPromptedForFeedback.description: Indicates whether the user has already been prompted to give feedback.

UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: Stores user-specific settings, such as dark/light mode preference.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user settings.

darkMode.description: Indicates whether dark mode is enabled.

enableTimer.description: Indicates whether the focus timer feature is enabled.

enableDailyChallenge.description: Indicates whether the daily challenge feature is enabled.

enableTodoList.description: Indicates whether the todo list feature is enabled.

PrivacySettings.title: PrivacySettings
PrivacySettings.description: Stores user-specific privacy settings for sharing data with friends.

id.description: Unique identifier, same as the userId.

shareTotalFocusTime.description: If true, the user's total focus time is visible to friends.

participateInLeaderboards.description: If true, the user will appear on friend-only leaderboards.

shareSubjectBreakdown.description: If true, friends can see the breakdown of time per subject.

FocusGridState.title: FocusGridState
FocusGridState.description: Stores the state of the accountability grid.

id.description: Unique identifier for the grid state.

gridData.description: JSON string representing the serialized state of the grid (focus, partial, rest states).

date.description: The date this focus grid state was recorded for.

id.description: Unique identifier for the daily question.

questionText.description: The text of the daily question, potentially with LaTeX markup.

subject.description: The subject of the daily question (e.g., Combined Maths, Chemistry, Physics).

date.description: The date this question was active.

UserDailyQuestionState.title: UserDailyQuestionState
UserDailyQuestionState.description: Stores the user-specific state for a daily question (e.g., whether it's solved).

id.description: Unique identifier for the user's daily question state.

solvedToday.description: Indicates whether the user has solved the question today.

Todo.title: Todo
Todo.description: Represents a single to-do item for a user, with support for nesting.

id.description: Unique identifier for the to-do item.

text.description: The content of the to-do item.

completed.description: Indicates whether the to-do item has been completed.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the to-do was created.

userId.description: The ID of the user who owns this to-do item.

parentId.description: The ID of the parent to-do item, if this is a sub-task.

order.description: A number used for ordering tasks within the same level.

Friendship.title: Friendship
Friendship.description: Represents a bi-directional connection between two users.

id.description: Unique identifier for the friendship document.

userIds.description: An array containing the two user IDs of the friends.

status.description: The status of the friendship request.

requesterId.description: The ID of the user who sent the friend request.

Notification.title: Notification
Notification.description: Represents a notification for a user (e.g., friend request, leaderboard change).

userId.description: The ID of the user who receives the notification.

fromUserId.description: ID of the user who triggered the notification.

version.description: A unique version identifier for the announcement (e.g., 'v1.1.0').

content.description: The main content of the announcement, can include markdown.

publishedAt.description: The date and time when the announcement was published.

StudyInsight.title: StudyInsight
StudyInsight.description: Stores a cached AI-generated analysis of a user's study data.

id.description: Unique ID for the insight, typically the generation date (YYYY-MM-DD).

userId.description: The ID of the user this insight belongs to.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the insight was generated.

focusStreak.description: Current number of consecutive days with focused time.

keyInsight.description: The main insight or trend identified by the AI.

suggestions.description: A list of actionable suggestions from the AI.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed to address the 'auth/configuration-not-found' error and support the GridFocus application's features while adhering to the principles of Authorization Independence, Structural Segregation, Access Modeling, and Data Clarity.  The error indicates a misconfiguration of the Firebase Authentication setup in the Next.js application. The structure is organized to facilitate straightforward and secure data access rules.  User-specific data is stored under `/users/{userId}` paths to ensure clear ownership and simplified security rules. Denormalization is employed for authorization, specifically within the `FocusGridState` and `UserDailyQuestionState` collections, where the `userId` is included to allow for direct querying and secure `list` operations without relying on parent document reads. This also supports atomic operations. The structure also supports secure `list` operations by segregating data based on ownership.  The use of path-based ownership for user data (`/users/{userId}/...`) simplifies security rules and ensures that users can only access their own data. Collaborative data is not a requirement for this application, thus no membership maps are needed.
